iee_instances_one_holder.name: iee_instances_one_holder
iee_instances_one_holder.value:
("iee_instances"."holder_kind" = 'player' and "iee_instances"."holder_player_id" is not null and "iee_instances"."holder_cell_index" is null and "iee_instances"."holder_roll_id" is null)
        or ("iee_instances"."holder_kind" = 'cell' and "iee_instances"."holder_cell_index" is not null and "iee_instances"."holder_player_id" is null and "iee_instances"."holder_roll_id" is null)
        or ("iee_instances"."holder_kind" = 'roll' and "iee_instances"."holder_roll_id" is not null and "iee_instances"."holder_player_id" is null and "iee_instances"."holder_cell_index" is null)

iee_instances_ended_has_reason.name: iee_instances_ended_has_reason
iee_instances_ended_has_reason.value: ("iee_instances"."status" = 'active' and "iee_instances"."end_reason" is null) or ("iee_instances"."status" = 'ended' and "iee_instances"."end_reason" is not null)
